tests.title: Loyalty settings display points, tiers, and redemption policy
tests.goal: A CRM user can review the active loyalty program configuration.
preconditions: Dedicated Storeberry Flower staging admin account is configured in local .env.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Loyalty > Loyalty Setting.
Review the program active state, membership levels, point earning, redemption, wallet, and referral sections.
Reload the page and confirm the values are still displayed.

expected.text: The loyalty setting page displays its active state, membership levels, point-earning policy, redemption conversion, wallet settings, and referral settings.
The displayed configuration remains unchanged after reload.

checks.label: The loyalty setting page displays its active state, membership levels, point-earning policy, redemption conversion, wallet settings, and referral settings.
The displayed configuration remains unchanged after reload.

notes: Reviewed active loyalty, levels 1-9, earning policy, redemption 100 points to HKD100 with HKD100 order cap, wallet and referral configuration. Basic and referral accessibility snapshots matched before and after reload. No settings changed.

tests.title: Category tree preserves parent-child hierarchy
tests.goal: The category Tree View displays a child category under its configured parent.
preconditions: At least one parent category with a child is available.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Categories > Tree view.
Choose an existing parent category that has at least one child.
Compare the child placement with the All Categories list.

expected.text: The child category is nested under the selected parent in Tree View.
The parent and child names correspond to the same category records in All Categories.

checks.label: The child category is nested under the selected parent in Tree View.
The parent and child names correspond to the same category records in All Categories.

notes: All Categories showed parent 水晶 (321), 綠髮 (322) with hierarchy 水晶/綠髮, and 超七 (323) with hierarchy 水晶/超七. Tree View nested both children under 水晶. Read-only.

tests.title: Brand search matches the brand and product count
tests.goal: A CRM user can locate a brand by name or ID and review its product association count.
preconditions: At least one brand exists in staging.
data: Existing brand name or ID, selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Brands.
Select an existing brand and note its name or ID.
Search for the exact brand name or ID.
Review the matching row and product-count link.

expected.text: The search returns the selected brand.
The row displays the brand identity and its product count; the count is not hard-coded.

checks.label: The search returns the selected brand.
The row displays the brand identity and its product count; the count is not hard-coded.

notes: Selected existing Huggies brand ID20 with product-count link 2. Exact-name search returned one row, same brand ID/name and count link 2. Read-only.
